query:
WITH scope AS (
                SELECT tu.team_id FROM team_user tu WHERE tu.user_id = $1 AND (tu.crm_access OR tu.team_role <> 'member')
                UNION ALL
                SELECT $2::uuid
            )
            SELECT co.id AS "company_id?", NULL::uuid AS "contact_id?",
                   LOWER(BTRIM(d.domain)) AS "domain?", NULL::text AS "email?"
            FROM crm_companies co
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT d.domain FROM crm_domains d WHERE d.company_id = co.id OFFSET 0
            ) d ON TRUE
            WHERE NOT co.hidden
              AND co.team_id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT team_id FROM scope))
            UNION ALL
            -- Contacts under a visible company.
            SELECT NULL, ct.id, NULL, address.email
            FROM crm_companies co
            -- Fence contacts by company before applying team and visibility filters.
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT ct.id, ct.team_id, ct.hidden
                FROM crm_contacts ct
                WHERE ct.company_id = co.id
                OFFSET 0
            ) ct
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT ce.email FROM crm_contact_emails ce WHERE ce.contact_id = ct.id OFFSET 0
            ) address ON TRUE
            WHERE NOT co.hidden
              AND co.team_id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT team_id FROM scope))
              AND ct.team_id = co.team_id AND NOT ct.hidden
            UNION ALL
            -- Contacts without a company.
            SELECT NULL, ct.id, NULL, address.email
            FROM (
                SELECT ct.id, ct.company_id, ct.hidden
                FROM crm_contacts ct
                WHERE ct.team_id = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT team_id FROM scope))
                OFFSET 0
            ) ct
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT ce.email FROM crm_contact_emails ce WHERE ce.contact_id = ct.id OFFSET 0
            ) address ON TRUE
            WHERE ct.company_id IS NULL
              AND NOT ct.hidden
